description: This is the main activity class for an Android application, implementing a calculator UI with voice input capabilities. It manages UI elements such as buttons, text views, and a voice search bar, and handles interactions like appending calculator symbols and clearing input.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the calculator app, managing UI and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI components, and binds event listeners.

methods.name: updateCurrentExpression
methods.description: Updates the display with the current expression string.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up all calculator keypad button click listeners to append symbols to the input.
